title: The Window a Points Settlement Target Is Drawn From
content:
The window from which the settlement target is drawn on a card under Personal Credit Cards is read from the money the cardholder moves through Personal Checking and from whether Personal Checking has charged them a fee.

**Where Piedmont Crescent Bank checking deposits posted to the cardholder's checking accounts in the last six months total at least 12000.00 USD and no Piedmont Crescent Bank checking fee was posted to those accounts in the last six months** — the settlement target is the fees and interest posted to the card account in the last six months, less the fee reversals credited to it in the last six months, and never less than 0.00 USD.

**Where those deposits total at least 12000.00 USD and at least one Piedmont Crescent Bank checking fee was posted to those accounts in the last six months** — the settlement target is the fees and interest posted to the card account in the last three months, less the fee reversals credited to it in the last three months, and never less than 0.00 USD.

**Where those deposits total less than 12000.00 USD** — the settlement target is the fees and interest posted to the card account in the last month, less the fee reversals credited to it in the last month, and never less than 0.00 USD.

| Checking deposits in the last six months | Checking fees in the last six months | Window the target is drawn from |
|---|---|---|
| 18000.00 USD | none | the last six months |
| 18000.00 USD | 1 | the last three months |
| 12000.00 USD | none | the last six months |
| 11999.00 USD | none | the last month |
| 11999.00 USD | 4 | the last month |

The deposit figure is read as at least, so deposits of exactly 12000.00 USD belong with the higher band. Where the deposits fall short of it, the fee count is not reached at all: the window is the last month whether or not a checking fee was posted. Within every window the same three elements are taken — the fees and the interest posted to the card account, less the fee reversals credited to it, and never less than 0.00 USD — and only the length of the window changes.
